HE.note: Class I membrane protein with sialate-9-O-acetylesterase (receptor-destroying) and lectin activity, forming the short 6 nm surface projections (PMID 9188596); substrate preference differs between bovine and porcine torovirus (PMID 15507445) and both ectodomains have been crystallised (PMID 19721004). Not essential in culture (PMID 34817201), and absent as a functional gene from equine torovirus, where it is a deleted pseudogene (PMID 29950409) -- hence no copy_num.

M.note: Triple-spanning envelope protein, 233 aa, described as the torovirus E protein in PMID 2024492 and called M since. Toroviruses have no coronavirus-like small envelope protein (PMID 33800523).

MPRO.anno: Main protease involved in polyprotein cleavage
MPRO.note: The torovirus main proteinase, cut from pp1a at its own two published cleavage sites rather than modelled from deposits -- nothing in BV-BRC is annotated as a torovirus mature peptide. Both sites were mapped by Edman degradation of the cleavage products: equine torovirus Gln3251|Ser3252 in SNFSFQ|SVFSKA and Gln3543|Ser3544 in QPFKKQ|SVSNNV, mature protein 292 aa (PMID 16571831, GenBank DQ310701); porcine torovirus Gln3095|Ser3096 and Gln3382|Ser3383, mature protein 287 aa (PMID 32727876, GenBank MH603532). Measured over all 32 pp1a sequences in this module's collection, P1 is Gln and P1' is Ser at 100% at BOTH ends, and the derived products are 287-292 aa. It is a chymotrypsin-like SERINE protease (nucleophile Ser, mature numbering Ser165) that nevertheless cleaves after Gln, consensus FxxQ|(S,A).

N.note: 160-163 aa phosphoprotein, far smaller than the coronavirus N (PMID 2607340); carries nuclear and nucleolar localisation and export signals that matter for virus growth (PMID 33177195).

ORF1A.note: pp1a, 4,417-4,569 aa. Processed by the virus's own main proteinase and a papain-like protease; 13 nsps are described for Torovirus (PMID 33800523). Only the main proteinase's own boundaries are experimentally mapped, so it is the only mature peptide this module declares.

ORF1AB.build_note: min_len/max_len in amino acids, from the 44 transcript_edit references this build wrote: observed 6505-6857 aa, with 10% slack either side.
ORF1AB.note: Expressed by -1 ribosomal frameshifting at the slippery heptamer U_UUA_AAC with a 3' pseudoknot; ORF1a and ORF1b overlap by 12 nt and frameshift efficiency is 20-30%, measured at 27.5-29.9% by ribosome profiling in infected cells (PMID 2388833, PMID 29950409). No PSSM: the product is not collinear with the genome.

S.note: Type I fusion glycoprotein, 1,562-1,587 aa, 18 N-glycosylation sites, two heptad repeats; mediates haemagglutination in cell-adapted bovine torovirus (PMID 2219698, PMID 23420207). The mature protein is two subunits, but the scissile bond has never been mapped, so S1/S2 are not declared here.
